# .github/logo/

`%RepositoryName%` logos go here.

Folder structure looks like this:

```text
.github/logo/
├── %Repository%-Logo-%Height%x%Width%.png
├── %Repository%-Logo-light-%Height%x%Width%.png
├── %Repository%-Logo-dark-%Height%x%Width%.png
├── %Repository%-Logo-transparent-%Height%x%Width%.png
```
